_about: Goals rows (settings audit, 2026-09-27; user review 2026-09-27: defaults only, nothing here starts a Goal).

planning.verification.goal-template.label: Kind of job

options.ledger_to_plan_transfer: Turn a ledger into a plan

planning.verification.goal-template.help: Set in each template. A Goal started from a template begins with its kind of job.
planning.verification.goal-template.perWhere: Change it in each template: Memory & Automation › Goals & Automation › Templates.

planning.verification.goal-write-mode.label: What new Goals may change

options.leased_writer: Edit files, one writer at a time
options.parent_writer: Hand edits to the main assistant

planning.verification.goal-write-mode.help: From read only up to editing files. Each step down gives a Goal more room.

planning.verification.stall-detection.label: Spot helpers that stopped making progress
planning.verification.stall-detection.help: Flags a helper that has stopped making progress, without stopping it.

general.interaction.run-graph-mode.label: Progress graph opens on
general.interaction.run-graph-mode.help: What the graph of a Goal shows when you open it in the assistant chat.

general.interaction.graph-density.label: Graph detail
general.interaction.graph-density.help: How much of a Goal's steps the graph draws.

general.interaction.progress-widget-layo.label: Progress view layout
general.interaction.progress-widget-layo.help: Which panels a Goal's progress view shows, and where.

planning.verification.goal-replan-events.label: If I change my mind mid-Goal

options.immediate_hard_constraint: Apply it as a firm rule now

planning.verification.review-reviewer-co.label: How many reviewers
planning.verification.review-reviewer-co.help: From 1 to 8. The same model may repeat.

planning.verification.review-roster.label: Reviewers to use
planning.verification.review-roster.help: Personas that review, in order. Empty lets Puppet Master pick.

planning.verification.review-auto-repair.label: Review can fix things
planning.verification.review-auto-repair.help: Always off: review reports, fixing is a separate step.

planning.verification.receipt-type.label: Receipt strength
planning.verification.receipt-type.help: Earned from the checks a Goal passed, not chosen. Shown on each finished Goal in the assistant chat.

planning.verification.report-visibility.help: Show check reports always, only on failure, or never.
planning.verification.report-visibility.label: Show check reports

planning.verification.validators-by-node.label: Checks for each kind of step

safety.approvals.schedule-grace-minutes.label: Still run if late by up to
safety.approvals.schedule-grace-minutes.help: A late run still starts if it is no later than this.

safety.approvals.schedule-wind-down-minu.label: Stop starting big work before a window closes
safety.approvals.schedule-wind-down-minu.help: No new big step starts this close to the end, so the current one can finish.

safety.approvals.schedule-resume-next-wi.label: Resume paused work in the next window

safety.approvals.schedule-dst-policy.label: Daylight saving
safety.approvals.schedule-dst-policy.help: Runs keep local clock time; read only.

safety.approvals.schedule-missed-policy.label: If a scheduled run is missed

options.Cancel after grace: Skip it if it is too late

planning.verification.validation-pass.label: Double-check finished work
planning.verification.validation-pass.help: A second pass looks over the result before it is handed back.

planning.verification.independent-review.label: Never let the builder grade its own work
planning.verification.independent-review.help: The review is done by someone other than whoever did the work.

planning.verification.completion-receipt.label: Write a receipt when a Goal finishes
planning.verification.completion-receipt.help: What was checked, how, and what is left.

planning.verification.auditor-loop.label: Audit the work after each fix
planning.verification.auditor-loop.help: A fresh look after every repair, until it passes or the attempts run out.

planning.verification.true-blocker-escal.label: Tell me quickly about real roadblocks
planning.verification.true-blocker-escal.help: Something only you can unblock is flagged at once.

planning.verification.blocker-detail.label: Explain roadblocks fully
planning.verification.blocker-detail.help: What is stuck, why, and what would unblock it.

planning.verification.goal-auto-resume.label: Pick up where it left off
planning.verification.goal-auto-resume.help: After a restart or a lost connection, from the last saved point.
